claim: The one-click sample week is isolated from the real archive, can be reset, and its records vanish when its tab closes.
sandbox: fresh browser context; create one real block; enter /demo; mutate and reset sample; return to the untouched real block; close a second populated demo tab and assert no demo session storage or IndexedDB remains

claim: Leaving the demo for home, Privacy, Terms, or Param Factory clears the sample before navigation.
sandbox: fresh /demo; for each documented exit, assert six sample records, observe demo storage removal before navigation, and confirm same-origin destinations have no demo storage

claim: The weekly board adds, edits, copies, deletes, restores, and recalls the client for a known project.
sandbox: fresh /demo; use shipped project mapping; add, edit, copy, delete, and undo a work block

claim: Calendar files are reviewed and imported locally, including repeating events with an end date and overnight events; descriptions and billability require explicit choices.
where: how it works, local data section, privacy policy, README
sandbox: fresh /demo; import a local fixture with recurrence, private description, and overnight event; assert results, defaults, tab-only demo storage, and no off-origin requests

claim: Exports the selected week as an invoice-ready CSV with one row per visible work block.
where: workspace, how it works, privacy policy, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample week; download CSV; assert filename, complete header, row count, and sample fields

claim: Exports, erases, and restores the complete local JSON backup.
where: local data section, settings, privacy policy, README
sandbox: fresh /demo; export JSON; erase demo archive; restore downloaded file; assert sample returns

claim: Works offline after the first visit and supplies standard PWA installation metadata.
sandbox: fresh /demo on isolated service-worker origin; assert manifest name, standalone display, icons, and link; wait for control; go offline; reload; assert sample board and offline status

claim: The optional Pattern Deck saves reusable blocks and copies the previous week; core timecard tools stay free.
where: first-screen facts, paid section, terms, README
sandbox: fresh /demo with paid preview enabled; save a pattern; clone three prior blocks; assert current count and free-tier copy

claim: Normal timecard work uses browser storage without an account or third-party runtime, analytics, advertising, font, or script requests.
where: privacy policy, local data section, README
sandbox: fresh normal workspace; add a record; log every request; assert only same-origin requests, the real IndexedDB archive, no demo storage, no license, and no account controls

claim: Pattern Deck costs $18 once through Sociobot billing without an embedded payment provider; a new or restored token stays locked until verification succeeds, then a successful verdict is cached for one day.
where: paid section, unlock dialog, privacy policy, terms, README
sandbox: fresh normal workspace with a controlled clock; abort a forged returned-token verification and assert the locked state; assert the $18 once price, Sociobot checkout URL, same-origin scripts, and absence of payment frames or card fields; mock one successful restore; reload at 86,399,999 ms and assert no recheck; reload at 86,400,000 ms with a revoked response and assert Pattern Deck locks
